title: Tune the Feed
instruction: You run a video feed. Each video has two predictions: how likely you'll click it, and how likely you'll be glad you watched it. Set how much each one counts and watch the top 5 change.

toggles.label: Rule: at most 2 videos per topic
Rule: reserve 1 slot for a new creator

items.title: You won't believe what happens at 0:47
A local hiking trail, filmed by a first-time creator

goals.text: The feed ranks by predicted click only. Look at what wins.
goals.why: Clickbait and a celebrity feud take the top slots. They are the most clickable, and nothing else counts, so 'glad I watched' stays low.

goals.text: Get 'glad I watched' to 0.60 or more while keeping at least 70 % of the clicks.
goals.why: Blending a satisfaction prediction into the score gives up a few clicks for a feed people are glad they watched. The objective, not the algorithm, decides what a good feed is.

goals.text: Keep both, and also show at least 4 topics and at least 1 new creator.
goals.why: Weights alone rarely buy variety or a fair start for newcomers. Rules in the re-ranking step, like a topic cap or a reserved slot, do it directly, at a cost in clicks you can see.

toyNote: Toy predictions for illustration, not measurements from a real platform.
debrief: A ranking is a weighted objective plus rules. Whoever sets the weights decides what the feed is for: clicks, satisfaction, variety or a fair start for new creators.
